  process.

  Councilmember Gordo requested that staff provide information on
  the services provided by the Los Angeles County Department of

  through Rojo's Better Life Center agency; and determine if the
  City's Housing Department provides U.S. Department of Housing

  Pablo Alvarado, Pasadena Job Center, requested that the Mayor
  provide a proclamation to honor the contributions of immigrants
  and day labors to the community.

  and asked staff to provide information on the administrative

  the City's minimum wage, as well as the ongoing support provided

  importance of the community participating in the 2020 census.
